Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. After the harmful plants are mentioned, add a concrete physical result to make the danger vivid: “很多人吃了以后肚子疼，还会生病。”
2. When introducing Shennong, add his determined thought or a short line of inner speech: “神农想：我一定要找出能做药的植物。”

ideas.reason: It adds a concrete consequence of eating unsafe plants and fits the scene.
It gives Shennong a fitting motivation that leads into his testing of plants.
